parole.significato: The twenty-first letter of the Norwegian Bokmål alphabet, written in the Latin script.
parole.testo: The lowercase form of U. From Latin V, from an Old Italic form of Ancient Greek Υ (U, “upsilon”), ultimately from Phoenician 𐤅 (w, “waw; hook”). In medieval Latin-script writing, ⟨u⟩ and ⟨v⟩ were positional forms of a single letter; they later became distinct letters, with ⟨u⟩ used for the vowel.

parole.significato: The twenty-second letter of the Norwegian Bokmål alphabet, written in the Latin script.
parole.testo: The uppercase form of v. From Latin V, from an Old Italic form of Ancient Greek Υ (U, “upsilon”), ultimately from Phoenician 𐤅 (w, “waw; hook”). In Latin, ⟨V⟩ originally represented both the vowel /u/ and the consonant /w/; the distinct letterforms ⟨U⟩ and ⟨V⟩ developed later.
